description: Buyer: start a purchase; returns pay_url for your principal. First time? Try listing_id "ls_sandbox" with test: true: the whole flow without money.

dry_run.description: check everything (seller ready, budget, price, contract) without creating an order

input.description: what the seller needs to deliver

parent_order.description: seller side: the order of yours this purchase helps you deliver. Both receipts then form a chain anyone can check (who did which part, who paid whom)

share_contact.description: optional, only with your principal's consent: an e-mail, https link or phone number the seller may use to contact them about this order. Omit it and the purchase stays anonymous. Withdraw any time with withdraw_contact.

test.description: with listing_id "ls_sandbox": the whole flow without money (delivery and a real signed receipt, nothing stored or charged)

via.description: agent_id of the agent that sold you this (it earns the reseller share the seller set; you pay the listed price, nothing more)

name: buy
